sourceNote: Simplified Chinese (zh-cn) card images sourced from the Hong Kong edition of the official Pokémon Asia card database (asia.pokemon-card.com/hk/), crawled offline by scripts/crawl-pokemon-cn-images.ts. Caveat: the HK site itself displays Traditional Chinese card text, so the art is correct but the text rendered on the image is Traditional, not Simplified. Every entry belongs to a set whose HK-printed set name was independently verified against our catalog Set.name before any of its cards were crawled (never assumed from a matching set-code string alone), and every card entry also passed a catalog-row and card-name match. Image URLs are derived from each card's internal id and hotlinked, never re-hosted.
